title: Authorization Fails Closed: Governance That Cannot Self-Extend

intelligence.essence: Power in this system is granted narrowly, exercised through rails, and denied loudly: a policy cannot extend itself (SN-0215), a candidate law never governs until every activation condition holds at once (SN-0262), mutations read their grants and fail closed (SN-0223), a director's spoken word authorizes one act and never becomes precedent (SN-0324), and what is uncertain travels honestly labeled CANDIDATE (SN-0325).
intelligence.human_view: A rule isn't real until the machine can't break it — until the wrong action is impossible, not just frowned upon. Turning a system "on" is never one switch; it's every condition true at once. Nobody's say-so — even the boss's, even in the moment — becomes a permanent permission afterward; it covers the one thing it covered.
intelligence.child_view: House rules work best when they're built into the house — a gate that won't open the wrong way, not just a sign saying "don't." One key never opens the treasure chest; you need all the keys turned together. "Mom said I could, that one time" doesn't mean "I can always." And if you don't know something, you say "I don't know yet" on the label — you never write down a guess as if it were a fact.
intelligence.grandma_view: A promise is fine, dear, but a lock is better — the best rules are the ones built into the door itself. No single key, and certainly no single person's word on a busy afternoon, should open everything forever. What's uncertain gets labeled uncertain, plainly.
intelligence.ai_view: Encode every ratified law as transitions that cannot be skipped; refuse single-flag activations by construction and test the refusal. Authenticate policy terms from the canonical record; hard-exclude protected paths. Read grants at mutation time, deny by default with named errors, carry authority refs on outputs. Ship fail-closed repairs with their provisioning sequenced. Verify shipped artifacts at full scope, not harness scope. Key trust on provenance and structure. Log verbal authorizations as single-act, precedent-free. Mark disclosed unknowns CANDIDATE; never upgrade them silently.
intelligence.what_it_means: Nine notes are the governance stack of the era, from constitutional activation down to a classifier's false-positives: power is granted narrowly, exercised through rails, denied loudly, and never self-extended. The director's own doctrines that frame this stack — law-as-code (SN-0269), the ratified Scorecard Law (SN-0342), Learn-Then-Ten-X (SN-0183), do-it-now (SN-0282) — are NOT covered here; under the campaign standing-authority rule they stand alone as single-note law, and this essence is their machinery, not their replacement.
whats_inside: Activation is a full conjunction; no single-flag path exists; candidates never govern (SN-0262).
Policies cannot self-extend; protected paths are structurally unpromotable (SN-0215).

Authorization is read from grants and fails closed with named denials; repairs ship with provisioning; shipped artifacts are proof-checked at full scope; trust keys on structure, not strings (SN-0223, SN-0221, SN-0224, SN-0225).

Verbal authority authorizes the single act only, never precedent (SN-0324); disclosed uncertainty rides as CANDIDATE (SN-0325); consent is granular — wisdom anonymized-collective, identity private (SN-275).
